column7: loginLocked and the pre-mint re-check compared the stored lockout failures and the in-memory fallback failures with MaxAttempts separately, so with the lockout-column write failing intermittently up to 2*(MaxAttempts-1) failures fit before a lock (#3029 review at 81a070aa). ADR-040 amendment: the check adds the in-memory count to the stored one. Now accountFailuresSpent sums the stored count inside Window and the fallback count. Red on 81a070aa: MaxAttempts failures split stored/in-memory in any order, then the correct password logged in; green: refused as locked. _RecheckSumsTheFreshStoredCount covers the re-check, _StoredAndFallbackBelowTheLimitStillLogsIn and _StoredFailuresOutsideTheWindowAreNotSummed are the calibrations.
